Its FALLING/RISING routing contradicts the signed contract: measurementPlan.sweeps + logPlan.logParamMapping + calculation require rising sweep (VBUS 3->5V, TRIG_FALLING) capture -> result FALLING -> param VBUS_PRST_Rise, and falling sweep (5->3V, TRIG_RISING) -> RISING -> VBUS_PRST_Fall; the pre-seed routes the rising-sweep capture into VBUS_PRST_Fall and the falling-sweep capture into VBUS_PRST_Rise (test.cpp:8896-8907).
